d:
Shehzad Poonawalla emerged as the winner of Rise and Fall Season 2! In this interview, he opens up about his decision to participate in the reality show, his friendship with Swara Bhasker, and his experience with fellow contestants.
He also shares his views on Tej Pratap Yadav and Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, talks about the relationships he built inside the show, and looks back at his journey to becoming the winner of Rise and Fall 2.

Video Editor: Ashish
